hikes.name: Spencer Butte
hikes.blurb: Eugene's summit: a short, steep climb to a rocky top over the city with the Three Sisters in the east.

hikes.name: Mount Pisgah
hikes.blurb: Up open oak and grass slopes to a summit with a bronze sighting monument and the whole valley below.

hikes.name: Brice Creek and Trestle Creek Falls
hikes.blurb: Along a clear swimming creek to a falls you can walk behind.

hikes.name: Mount June
hikes.blurb: The highest point near Eugene, a short climb to a meadow summit with the Cascades lined up.

hikes.name: Bohemia Mountain
hikes.blurb: A short steep climb from an old mining district to a summit with Shasta, Thielsen and the Sisters.

hikes.name: Station Butte
hikes.blurb: From Eugene to Crest Trailhead #1, an 11.5-mile round trip to the top of Station Butte (2,499 ft), with about 3,300 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Lookout Point
hikes.blurb: From Alpine Trailhead #2, an 11.1-mile round trip to the top of Lookout Point (3,297 ft), with about 2,300 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Tire Mountain
hikes.blurb: From Alpine Trailhead #3, a 7.6-mile round trip to the top of Tire Mountain (4,326 ft), with about 1,550 feet of climbing.
